name: Google Workspace Admin
hint: A web OAuth client in your Google Cloud project with the Admin SDK API enabled, and a Workspace admin’s refresh token for these scopes under https://www.googleapis.com/auth/: admin.directory.user.readonly, admin.directory.group.readonly, admin.directory.group.member, admin.directory.orgunit.readonly, admin.directory.device.chromeos.readonly, admin.directory.device.mobile.readonly, admin.directory.domain.readonly, admin.directory.rolemanagement.readonly, admin.reports.audit.readonly, admin.reports.usage.readonly, for example from the OAuth 2.0 Playground; an External app left in Testing gets tokens that end after 7 days.

pick.name: list_users
pick.says: Lists the users. Give customer my_customer for the account’s own organization, or domain for one domain; query searches, e.g. email:ada* or orgUnitPath=/Students. Without fields each user comes back whole: fields=users(primaryEmail,name/fullName,orgUnitPath,suspended),nextPageToken keeps the answer small.

pick.name: get_user
pick.says: Returns one user, by primary email, alias or ID; projection full adds the custom schema fields.

pick.name: list_groups
pick.says: Lists groups. Give customer my_customer for the account’s own organization, or domain; for the groups one user is in, give userKey and no customer. query searches, e.g. email:support* or name:contact*.

pick.name: get_group
pick.says: Returns one group, by email address, alias or ID.

pick.name: list_group_members
pick.says: Lists a group’s members, users and groups, each with its role: OWNER, MANAGER or MEMBER. includeDerivedMembership true also lists indirect members.

pick.name: list_org_units
pick.says: Lists organizational units. customerId my_customer is the account’s own organization; type all lists every level under orgUnitPath, the default only the immediate children.

pick.name: list_activities
pick.says: Lists the audit events of one application, applicationName such as login, drive (Google says its report is only available for Google Workspace Business and Enterprise customers), admin or groups, for userKey all or one user’s email; eventName and filters narrow it, e.g. login_success and is_suspicious==true. startTime and endTime are RFC 3339 and reach back 180 days; gmail needs both, at most 30 days apart.

pick.name: get_user_usage
pick.says: Returns usage statistics per user for one day: userKey all or one user’s email, date yyyy-mm-dd in Pacific Standard Time; parameters picks them, e.g. accounts:timestamp_last_login. A day whose data is not ready comes back with a warning.

pick.name: get_customer_usage
pick.says: Returns the organization’s usage statistics for one day: date yyyy-mm-dd in Pacific Standard Time; parameters picks them, e.g. accounts:num_30day_logins. A day whose data is not ready comes back with a warning.

pick.name: list_chromeos_devices
pick.says: Lists ChromeOS devices. customerId my_customer is the account’s own organization; query filters, e.g. status:provisioned or recent_user:ada@school.edu, and projection FULL returns every field.

pick.name: list_mobile_devices
pick.says: Lists user-owned mobile devices; company-owned ones need Google’s Cloud Identity Devices API. customerId my_customer is the account’s own organization; query filters, e.g. os:Android or status:approved.

pick.name: list_domains
pick.says: Lists the organization’s domains, with whether each is primary and verified. customer my_customer is the account’s own organization.

pick.name: list_admin_roles
pick.says: Lists the admin roles, prebuilt and custom, with the privileges each grants. customer my_customer is the account’s own organization.

pick.name: list_role_assignments
pick.says: Lists who holds which admin role, by role ID and assignee ID; userKey narrows it to one user or group. customer my_customer is the account’s own organization.

pick.name: add_group_member
pick.says: Adds a user or another group to a group. Body: {"email", "role": "MEMBER"}.
